newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's ENEL opens wind power plant.
newsitem.headline: Italy's ENEL opens wind power plant.

text.p: Italy's state-owned electricity generator and distributor ENEL SpA said on Tuesday it had opened its first commercial wind energy plant near Aquila in central Italy.

Enel said the plant at Collarmele, some 90 km (55 miles) northeast of Rome, would generate nine megawatts through 36 wind generators and would be able to meet the energy needs of some 20,000 people a year.
The company said another plant, with an 11 megawatt capacity, was under construction on the island of Sardinia and would become operative in 1998.
